title: Upcycling sawdust into sustainable binder-free nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber electrodes for high energy density supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15979-15991
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00480F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dalia M. El-Gendy, Hebat-Allah S. Tohamy, Ehab N. El Sawy
Pinewood sawdust waste was converted into nitrogen-doped carbon nanofibers for supercapacitors. The N-CNFs achieved a capacitance of 1280 F g−1 with 100% stability over 4000 cycles, offering a high-energy, sustainable storage solution for EVs.
